subject: Post-call: Northstar edge isolation & VPC constraints — recap and next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Brennan <tbrennan@northstartx.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@northstartx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T18:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: Northstar edge isolation & VPC constraints — recap and next steps

Hi Tom / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the NetOps deep-dive.

Key pain / drivers you shared:
- Regulatory requirement to keep PHI inside Texas datacenter region (must not cross into multi-tenant public zones).
- Planned air-gapped processing for certain workloads (periodic secure-swap via vaulted USB/storage transfer).
- Strict outbound egress controls (only whitelisted IPs, no third-party telemetry).
- Latency sensitivity for real-time triage: 50–150 ms p95 target for inference on short sequences.

Goals you described:
1) Proof-of-concept (2–4 week pilot) in a private VPC connected to Northstar's TX colo.
2) Clear runbook for secure data movement and attestable KMS/HSM integration.
3) Procurement-ready SOW + checklist for compliance team.

Open questions / constraints we need to validate:
- Network path: can you provide the colo network diagram and firewall ACL owner? (NetOps name/email).
- Do you require on-prem appliance (air-gapped) or is a VPC with transit gateway acceptable for pilot?
- Any mandatory crypto module vendor (HSM) or will a cloud KMS with customer-managed keys suffice for initial run?

Proposed next steps (pick dates that work for you):
1) Tech workshop (NetOps + Security + Redwood infra engineer) — 60 min — recommended this week.
2) Redwood to deliver: VPC connectivity checklist, sample SOW, and SOC2 snapshot by EOD Friday (attached).
3) Northstar to share: network diagram, ACLs, procurement timeline, and the NetOps contact.

Attachments I'm sending now: redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx, redwood-soc2-summary.pdf, sample-sow-redwood.docx (see attachment stubs below).

If that matches your expectations, we'll book the workshop and loop in Ben for the procurement details.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole | Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0142
Redwood Inference

Attachment stubs:
- redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (pdf, 3 pages)
- sample-sow-redwood.docx (Word, template)
From: Tom Brennan <tbrennan@northstartx.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@northstartx.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T09:08:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Northstar edge isolation & VPC constraints — recap and next steps

Marissa —

Appreciate the clear recap. That aligns with what we heard internally. Quick answers and a couple asks:

- We are required to keep PHI in-region (TX) and we also need an auditable chain for any data exfil/ingress.
- For the pilot we prefer a VPC in our dedicated colo (transit gateway to our router), not an on-prem appliance. The long-term ask may be more locked down but pilot should be VPC-only.
- NetOps contact: Priya Shah (cc'd) will coordinate and owns firewall rules; she can share the diagram.
- Procurement timeline: 8–10 weeks to execute an MSA + PO once SOW is approved.

Immediate requests:
1) Can you add a short paragraph in the SOW about key custody (customer KMS + Redwood not holding plaintext keys)?
2) We'll need a sample network diagram template from Redwood to drop into our design — helps speed procurement.

If you can get the checklist + SOC2 snapshot today that would help triage with security. We'll aim to have the NetOps packet to you by EOD tomorrow.

Thanks —
Tom Brennan
CTO, Northstar Therapeutics
tbrennan@northstartx.com | (512) 555-0199
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Brennan <tbrennan@northstartx.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@northstartx.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2027-06-24T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: Northstar edge isolation & VPC constraints — recap and next steps

Tom / Priya —

Perfect — thanks for the clarifications. A few quick notes based on your asks:

- SOW: we'll include the key-custody clause (explicitly: customer-managed KMS, Redwood has no persistent access to plaintext keys; we describe HSM usage patterns).
- Network template: attaching a lightweight diagram template (redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx has a tab with the topology sketch and recommended ACLs).
- SOC2 snapshot: attached (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf) with the control summary and auditor contact.

Proposed calendar items:
- Tech workshop: Thu 2027-06-26 10:00–11:00 CT (NetOps + Security + Ben from Redwood). Does that work?
- If confirmed, we'll send an event invite and a pre-read (network questions + IPs to whitelist).

I'll flag Ben to start compiling procurement-level pricing and options (dedicated Reserved vs pilot burst). Ben — can you pull high-level pricing bands and the sample SOW revisions by Friday?

Next artifacts you'll get from us today:
- redwood-vpc-checklist.xlsx (network template tab)
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf
- sample-sow-redwood.docx (with a placeholder key custody paragraph)

Thanks — looking forward to the workshop.

Best,
Marissa
